verdict: Ads are running, but no leads are flowing — setup milestones are the blocker.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $159.10 was spent on Meta and 308 clicks were recorded, but zero leads have been tracked — not because the ads are failing, but because the conversion infrastructure (landing pages, CRM intake, and conversion tracking) is not yet confirmed live. Nine project milestones are overdue, some dating back to July 31, and until those are in place there is no path for a click to become a counted lead. Google Search campaigns and local service ads are also not yet running, meaning paid search is entirely off this period. This week those overdue items — tracking setup, CRM connection, and landing page activation — are being completed as the immediate priority. Once that foundation is live, lead volume and cost per lead will become meaningful metrics; expect those to appear in the next report.
